notes: file_gb = summed HF file bytes (1e9). est_tps: 'measured' = cited llama.cpp result for that exact quant on that hardware; 'est' = bandwidth model (engine/pico/recipes.py). Benchmarks are vendor self-reported. Speculative-decoding gains are not included unless the runtime enables recipe.spec.
